extraction.target: Mean observed pressure indicator in the supplied eligible rookie rush cohort; conditional, not unconditional career success.
extraction.onset_weights: Equal source-only sensitivity scenarios .5,1,2 yd/s; not calibrated phase probabilities
extraction.frame_scope: Up to first 61 contiguous 10Hz active frames. Gaps rejected. Four operational ordered phase templates, not labeled physiology.

numerical_scope: Exact integer populations and ranks; binary64 log-weight inference and source observations. Rational reference API checked on small graphs.
formal_scope: Uses the finite partial-state language framework developed in ArithmeticModes. New numerical compiler, feature extraction and NFL regression are not formally verified.
summary: Retrospective stratification isolates pressure overprediction correction: 24 linebackers with lowered forecasts improve 55.19%, with 20 improving and positive gains in both observed classes. scouting_expansion.summary: Expanded to 2,533 drafted prospects and 66 public data archives. Source-guarded college inputs reduce retrospective two-season NFL usage error by 2.53% versus Combine traits; the interval includes zero, college-linked controls do not confirm it, and custom metrics add no dependable benefit. No scouting edge or pressure-rate improvement is established.

scouting_depth.summary: Expanded to 3,762 drafted prospects, 2,357 verified college feature links and 240 public archives. Historical production lowers conditional receiving-efficiency MSE 3.40%, with intervals including zero. Custom metrics worsen receiving error 4.86%; zero fallback rejects them in every class. No dependable custom-metric scouting improvement is established.

scouting_identity.summary: Historical identity audit: 2,790 name-and-birth verified college identities, 1,125 contextual recruiting candidates, zero authoritative/as-of recruitment features. A fixed convex blend reduces retrospective pressure-rate MSE 7.11% on 90 defenders, with player uncertainty crossing zero. No scouting model is promoted.

exposure_weighted.scope: Outcome-observed exposure changes the evaluation estimand; unavailable for pre-draft routing and not an intrinsic-ability adjustment.
